cast.name: 伊娃·赫兹格瓦 Eva Herzigova
费尔南多·林德斯 Fernando Lindez

introduction: In a city suspended between night and dawn, a group of strangers gathers in a quiet bar while the world outside seems to fall apart. Time stretches, gestures slow down, and every glance hides a confession never spoken. Eva, delicate yet determined, carries a secret she can no longer hold. Matteo, the silent observer, tries to read what others conceal. And then there's the dog-an emblem of humanity waiting for an answer, the last innocent witness to a society that has forgotten how to feel. The bar becomes a shelter, a fragile refuge where time stands still-a place impermeable to the chaos, where people seek warmth, contact, and a fleeting sense of belonging while everything outside collapses. Inside, amid music, smoke, and reflections, the characters move like fragments of the same dream. It's here, in the space between-between words, between people-that tenderness becomes a quiet form of rebellion. The Gentle Society is a film about connection and distance, about the fragile beauty of those who still believe that gentleness can resist the noise of the world.
